leadText: Child of the Jungle (Korean: 정글의 아이 Jeongeurui Ai) is the opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle . It is performed by FiNE.
plainText:
Child of the Jungle (Korean: 정글의 아이 Jeongeurui Ai) is the opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle . It is performed by FiNE.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

Oh oh now
 
 
light up the night
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

A stray life blooms
Within a noble breath
A dazzling light illuminates the path
Warmth fills the same space
Together during this fateful time
The soft whisper of a young life
Listen

Woo~~ woah woah~~
Woo~~ woah woah~~
Illuminating the darkness
Are the moonlit translucent eyes
Hiding behind my back
The wings spread out

Oh oh now
Right this moment
Both eyes filled
Light up the night
This land blooms
A small courage

You, me, us, and
Looking upon the world heaven has given us
A stray ray of life
Let's make it
Woo~ woah woah~
Always shine your light on this path
 

==Video==
